thread:
tia: Heads-up — EdgeStor (HW) + CloudBazaar (SI) aiming for marketplace listing. Legal asked whether firmware needs notarization or if vendor-signed PDF is sufficient. Launch target 2024-05-30.
lucas: tagging security + partnerships. timeline tight. who owns notarization if required?
emily: Security perspective: for firmware that runs on customer hardware we prefer notarization OR a notarized signature from a recognized CA. Vendor-signed PDF ok if the firmware is microcontroller-level and notarization not feasible, but we need reproducible build evidence and signed commit hashes.
raj: EdgeStor can provide a signed firmware-attest.pdf + reproducible-build.txt containing git SHA256 and build env. Notarization will add 7-10 days.
maria: CloudBazaar timeline: we can delay listing by a week if notarization is required, but prefer to get everything in presigned intake for now. We need: soc2.pdf (or bridge), pen_test_report.zip (passworded), firmware-attest.pdf, sbom.spdx.csv, reproducible-build.txt, ci-provenance.log, questionnaire.md, and remediation-tracker.csv.
olivia: pen vendor is SecureProbe (secprobe@example.com). They will include CVSS, proof-of-test-dates, and a list of Jira/Ticket IDs for remediations. Can we upload raw findings to the presign bucket?
emily: yes — raw findings go into presigned S3 path with SSE-KMS. Public listing only gets redacted-summary.pdf. Raw should be uploaded as password-protected zip and password shared out-of-band to security-reviews.
bен: (ben): small ops Q — which KMS alias should partners use for SSE-KMS? Also can ingest accept s3 object metadata for build-hash?
maria: use alias/marketplace-ingest-prod. Please include build-hash in object metadata header x-amz-meta-build-hash. We'll validate against reproducible-build.txt.
raj: EdgeStor will upload artifacts to s3://rw-marketplace-partner-ingest/cloudbazaar/edgestor-v1/. Can we get presigned PUTs with 3-day expiry? Some partners prefer shorter windows.
maria: default is 7 days, but for this listing we can issue 3-day presigns. I'll generate them and paste links. Example upload CLI:
```
# presigned PUT example
curl -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/zip" --upload-file pen_report.zip
```
ingest-bot: New runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/partner-ingest-provenance (see section 4: firmware + build provenance) :page_with_curl: 
olivia: question re: notarization — if EdgeStor chooses notarization route, do we need notarized attestation and notarized SBOM?
emily: notarized firmware attestation is highest value. Notarized SBOM optional but we need signed SBOM from vendor (SPDX + signature). If notarization delays listing and partner can't wait, we'll accept signed artifacts plus CI provenance and a signed statement of notarization timeline.
ben: encryption follow-up — partners may prefer client-side envelope encryption. We support that; partner must provide KMS thumbprint to allow RW to decrypt. Add note to checklist.
lucas: owners recap: CloudBazaar -> coordinate SI deliverables + redaction requests; EdgeStor -> firmware, sbom, reproducible build; Security -> verify raw artifacts + pen vendor chain-of-custody; Partnerships (maria) -> presigns + checklist + KMS alias.
maria: I'll own presigns and checklist. Expected rough uploads: firmware-attest.pdf + sbom.spdx.csv by 2024-04-24, pen_report.zip draft by 2024-04-28, SOC draft by 2024-04-26. I'll post presigned URLs here once live and attach required_files.txt to the runbook.
olivia: we'll aim for those dates. Pen vendor will send signed scope statement to security-reviews@redwood.com.
emily: request to vendors: include a notarization decision flag in questionnaire.md (values: notarize_yes / notarize_no / pending). Also include contact info for the CA/notary if chosen.
raj: understood. EdgeStor will set notarization flag = pending for now.
lucas: ok schedule a 30m checkpoint 2024-04-25 to confirm presigns and any notarization blockers. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
